source_notes: GEM's listed on-site vessel (Energos Eskimo, ex-Golar Eskimo) is stale. The Energos Eskimo departed Aqaba in June 2025 at the end of its NEPCO charter and sailed to Egypt (10-yr EGAS/NFE charter, deployed at Ain Sokhna). The Energos Force FSRU arrived at Aqaba ~1 Aug 2025 (operations from ~5 Aug 2025) as an interim unit on an EGAS sub-charter (originally on charter from Germany's DET). IMPORTANT/TRANSITIONAL: Energos Force was reported to end its ~6-month Aqaba charter in Dec 2025 (handled ~4 cargoes / ~14 Bcf), and the long-term replacement is a BW LNG FSU under a 10-yr NEPCO charter at the new Sheikh Sabah onshore terminal (start Q3-Q4 2026, NEPCO to own vessel at charter end). As of this sweep (2026-06) the live on-site vessel should be re-confirmed directly before applying. Both Energos Eskimo and Energos Force are Energos vessels (NFE/Apollo JV), so VesselOwner 'New Fortress Energy' and Operator 'Energos' remain valid and were left unchanged.
scope_note: Linking/sync field per FSRU sync rule (vessel name shared with carrier project). Vessel reassignment is real but the current Energos Force deployment is interim; staged yellow and accompanied by a qa note so the reviewer can confirm the mid-2026 occupant before applying.

source_notes: Aqaba Development Corp (ADC) awarded the EPCIC contract for the 720 MMcfd onshore regasification terminal to the GAS Entec / AG&P International consortium (with local partner Issa Haddadin) in Aug 2024; the project is described as a 22-month build with commissioning in Q2 2026 (operations ~Sep 2026). Jordan's energy minister inspected on-site construction progress in Oct 2025. This puts the project firmly in construction, so ConstructionYear 2024 should be added (currently blank). See accompanying qa note for the proposed->construction status change (no Status field edit per rules).
